sprint_goal_verdict.note: All 20 planned units (52 points) and five added in-run (6 points) delivered on independent APPROVEs, five after one repair round and US1156 after a carry answered in-run (BG1439). A release's change evidence pack is one command over committed records, naming each change's accountable person (US1155, US1156); the evidence annex documents every committed record a consumer parses, with a recomputable fingerprint and a version stamp (EP0275); the plan forecasts priced, dollar and wall-clock cost and the report states forecast, actual and ratio for every cost row (US1150, US1151); a multi-unit lane's builder is now priced per unit (BG1397). Grouping the pack by risk class is carried as CR0704, and the dollar forecast's formula, which runs high for Opus, as CR0703. BG1420 is Fixed, which clears the 6.4 tag's known-issues bar.
